Recompose the hero so bow and type are one picture: the boot stripe runs out of the bow under the h1 as its baseline (headline above the line, naming trade and city), lead and buttons pulled up to it, proof strip seated below the waterline as the chalky zone, hero ending high enough for services to peek.
